prompt:
你是本次 aris:novelty-check 技能要求的新上下文复核员。只读，不修改任何文件，不再生成子代理。请用中文，1000字内，独立核查以下方法与证据，尤其从研究问题/insight层面判断，不要以不同数据集/维度/模块排列代替新颖性。可以使用web读取以下原文链接核实，拒绝没有证据的完全重复/完全新颖断言。

用户拟在原FDAS上扩刊。原FDAS是SAM区域mask指导融合、分割、重建、原图融合图对比。拟新方法（用户主张，不是已确认事实）：
1. SAM mask -> SAM区域特征 -> 全数据K-means -> 跨病例共享伪类k。用户报告FLARE cluster purity95.7%，未提供计算口径/原始统计。
2. batch选同一伪类k，主图A取其k区域M_A^k，辅助图B取相同几何位置内容，融合C=(1-M)A+MB。B该位置不要求属于k。
3. 区域对比：C保留A区域特征与A在同区特征为正；C来自B的填充区与B同几何位置特征为正。负样本：C的A来源非k部分与其他病例的k区域推远；强调‘来源决定positive、伪语义决定negative’，不强制不同病例同簇直接作positive。
4. 原FDAS面积排序mask类别改为跨病例共享K类伪分割监督；尚未说明融合C的标签是A原图类别还是按A/B实际来源混合。
5. C重建A仍保留。
用户要：是否能讲成可信扩刊主线、是否有完全相同文献、如何从问题/insight描述差别，不是罗列实验形式。

已找到的原文（须区分结论与证据）：
A ALPS, An Auto-Labeling and Pre-training Scheme for Remote Sensing Segmentation With Segment Anything Model, arXiv2406.10855 / TIP2025。https://arxiv.org/pdf/2406.10855 方法页2-4（PDF页3-5）：SAM masks+SAM region feature+onlineKmeans+跨图伪类+segmentation pretrain。正文还有medical external validation（PDF页10），所以不能仅以医学vs遥感区分。
B RegionCL: Exploring Contrastive Region Pairs for Self-supervised Representation Learning, ECCV2022。https://www.ecva.net/papers/eccv_2022/papers_ECCV/papers/136930468.pdf 或 https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.12309。paste/canvas两个来源区域，按相同来源建立正、异来源建立负。直接覆盖来源感知融合区域positive。
C UM-SAM, Unsupervised Medical Image Segmentation using Knowledge Distillation from Segment Anything Model, MICCAI2025。https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2025/paper/2296_paper.pdf ROI池化SAMfeatures后Kmeans、依据目标面积/形状选择目标cluster；target-specific无监督分割，pseudo-label KD、classfeature KD、classcontrastKD。sec2.2同类SAM/student prototypes作正、异类作负。没有已确认源融合正样本。
D ReCo, Bootstrapping Semantic Segmentation with Regional Contrast, ICLR2022。https://www.imperial.ac.uk/media/imperial-college/research-centres-and-groups/dyson-robotics-lab/ShikunLiu_etal_iclr2022.pdf region classprototype positives、异类语义负样本及自适应负类采样，监督/半监督，非完全无标签pretraining。
E SlotCon, Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning with Semantic Grouping, NeurIPS2022。https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2022/file/6818dcc65fdf3cbd4b05770fb957803e-Paper-Conference.pdf 共享semantic prototypes、组区域slot、same prototype+same sample跨增强正样本、slotcontrast。可能与角色分离问题更接近。
F Self-Supervised Dense Representation Learning With Inter-Image Information（作者站PDF，正式venue尚未确认）https://sroutray.github.io/uploads/inter_image.pdf 对SlotCon拓展语义相似/不相似图采样跨图正负。不要编venue。
G MixCo: Mix-up Contrastive Learning for Visual Representation, arxiv2010.06300，mixed图相对两来源的semi-positive关系，较广泛先例。
H From SAM to CAMs, CVPR2024。https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2024/papers/Kweon_From_SAM_to_CAMs_Exploring_Segment_Anything_Model_for_Weakly_CVPR_2024_paper.pdf SAMmask不等类别、同一对象多块，pixel/prototype对比，image-level labels。
I SPARC, SuperPixel-Aware Region Contrastive Learning for Self-Supervised Dense Prediction, arxiv2609.25067。https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25067 摘要：superpixel跨增强显式对应+区域与全局contrast；未读完整方法。
检索多组关键词SAM clustering pseudo-semantic semantic negative region mixing source contrastive，以及近半年arxiv和CVF/MICCAI，尚未找到精确全链条同一篇。这个检索边界不是不存在的证明。

请重点回答：最接近prior是哪几篇；‘sourcepositive/semanticnegative’是否仅是ALPS+RegionCL/ReCo的直观拼接，或有可以成立的具体问题导向增量；用户方案中当前最严重的推论是什么；给一个审慎但能推进工作的清晰结论；最终建议问题与insight各一句。

=== NOVELTY VERDICT LIMITS (these bound how you judge, never how widely you search) ===
Search exhaustively; judge calibrated. Two failures waste months equally:
passing an idea a published paper already contains, and killing a viable idea
because the territory has neighbors.
1. Proximity is information, not a verdict. Someone working nearby goes in the
   report; it is not by itself a reason to reject.
2. ABANDON has exactly one qualification: a specific published paper already
   contains this result — name that paper. No named paper, no ABANDON.
3. Crowded-but-deltaed is PROCEED: state the delta in one sentence a reviewer
   could verify. Thin or contested delta is PROCEED WITH CAUTION — say what
   would make it carry, not why it should die. CAUTION is not a safe middle:
   if you cannot name the specific thing that makes the delta thin, the
   verdict is PROCEED.
4. Concurrent or competing work is not a veto. That is a race — report it and
   let the user decide whether to run it.
5. A direct attack on a central problem is legitimate novelty when nobody has
   executed it well. "This area is hot" does not mean "this area is taken."
6. This check is an early gate, never the last one — more triage, pilots, or
   external review still stand between any idea and a paper, whatever order
   this run uses. A wrongly passed idea dies cheaply at one of them; a wrongly
   killed idea is never seen again. When torn between two verdicts, choose the
   more permissive one.
Say plainly when an idea clears the check. Do not manufacture overlap.
followup_correction: 关键更正：我刚读到UM-SAM sec2.1原文明确写 ‘Due to SAM’s lack of semantics ... DINO ... feature extractor’，ROI聚类用DINO特征，不是SAM特征（https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2025/paper/2296_paper.pdf PDF页4，行155–180）。SAM特征用于后续KD。请纠正初始brief中C那句话，并据原文评估，不要复述错误。ALPS原文确实用SAM features。此外请关注：同一器官可能多个纯簇，因此95.7%purity并不排除跨簇同器官假负；B同几何区不必是k；C伪分割的标签目标需要分清visible-composite与重建原图。
